title: How to Say Thank You in Marathi — धन्यवाद + 6 Real Ways
description: Thank you in Marathi is धन्यवाद (dhanyavād). Learn formal and casual thanks, how to reply when someone thanks you, and the phrases Maharashtrians actually use.
lead: Thank you in Marathi is धन्यवाद (dhanyavād) — the same word Hindi speakers already know. But daily Marathi thanks sounds a little different: casual, warm, and often answered with काही हरकत नाही (no problem).
mistakes: ❌ थँक यू → ✅ धन्यवाद (English loan 'thanks' is heard in cities, but धन्यवाद always works)
❌ धन्यवाद आहे → ✅ आभारी आहे (the 'I am grateful' form uses आभारी, not धन्यवाद)
tip: Replying matters more than the thanks itself. When someone says धन्यवाद, answer काही हरकत नाही (it's nothing) — that exchange is the daily politeness loop in Maharashtra.

faqs.question: What is thank you in Marathi?
faqs.answer: धन्यवाद (dhanyavād) — identical to the Hindi word, so Hindi speakers can use it immediately. A warmer casual option is ढेरीस धन्यवाद.

faqs.question: How do you reply to thank you in Marathi?
faqs.answer: काही हरकत नाही (kāhī harakat nāhī — 'no problem') or ठीक आहे ('it's fine'). Both work as 'you're welcome'.

faqs.question: Is धन्यवाद formal or casual?
faqs.answer: It is neutral — fine everywhere. For very formal thanks use आभारी आहे ('I am grateful'); with friends a simple धन्यवाद or even English 'thanks' is common.

title: Hello in Marathi — नमस्कार vs नमस्ते vs काय चाललं?
description: Hello in Marathi is नमस्कार (namaskār). Learn when to use it, the casual काय चाललं?, phone hellos, and how each greeting changes with who you meet.
lead: Hello in Marathi is नमस्कार (namaskār) — said with folded hands, it works with elders, strangers and shopkeepers alike. Friends get something shorter: काय चाललं? (what's up?).

phrases.en: Hello, how are you? (to a friend)

mistakes: ❌ Using नमस्ते with elders → ✅ नमस्कार (the respectful default in Maharashtra)
❌ काय चाललं? with strangers → ✅ keep it for friends; strangers get नमस्कार
tip: नमस्कार literally bows ('I salute you') — that's why it never feels out of place, from a rickshaw driver to your boss's boss.

faqs.question: What is hello in Marathi?
faqs.answer: नमस्कार (namaskār) is the standard respectful hello. नमस्ते also exists but is lighter and often doubles as goodbye.

faqs.question: Do Marathi speakers say Namaste?
faqs.answer: Less often than Hindi speakers. नमस्कार is the Marathi default; नमस्ते is understood but sounds borrowed.

faqs.question: How do friends say hi in Marathi?
faqs.answer: काय चाललं? (kāy chālalaṁ? — 'what's going on?') among friends, or just हाय / हॅलो in cities.

title: Good Morning in Marathi — शुभ सकाळ vs सुप्रभात
description: Good morning in Marathi is शुभ सकाळ (śubh sakāḷ). Learn सुप्रभात, when Maharashtrians skip the greeting entirely, and morning phrases that follow it.
lead: Good morning in Marathi is शुभ सकाळ (śubh sakāḷ). You will also hear सुप्रभात (suprabhāt) — borrowed from Sanskrit and common on radio, in offices and in textbooks.
mistakes: ❌ सुप्रभात to the milkman → ✅ a simple नमस्कार (सुप्रभात sounds formal in casual settings)
❌ शुभ सकाळ after noon → ✅ switch to नमस्कार (Marathi has no strong 'good afternoon' habit)
tip: In real life, morning greetings are often just नमस्कार + a smile. Save शुभ सकाळ for messages, meetings and formal moments — it is never wrong, just a touch dressed-up.

faqs.question: What is good morning in Marathi?
faqs.answer: शुभ सकाळ (śubh sakāḷ). A formal alternative is सुप्रभात (suprabhāt), common on radio and in offices.

faqs.question: Do people actually say good morning in Maharashtra?
faqs.answer: Often a plain नमस्कार replaces it in casual talk. शुभ सकाळ appears in texts, schools and formal settings.

faqs.question: How do you reply to शुभ सकाळ?
faqs.answer: Say it back — शुभ सकाळ — or simply नमस्कार. Either is natural.

title: Sorry in Marathi — माफ करा, क्षमस्व & a Real Apology
description: Sorry in Marathi is माफ करा (māph karā). Learn the formal क्षमस्व, how to say 'my mistake', and why माफ करा also means excuse me.
lead: Sorry in Marathi is माफ करा (māph karā) — and the same phrase doubles as excuse me. One phrase covers bumping into someone, interrupting, and apologising.
mistakes: ❌ माफ़ कीजिए (Hindi) → ✅ माफ करा (the Marathi form drops the Hindi -कीजिए)
❌ Using क्षमस्व with friends → ✅ it is ceremonial; friends get a casual माफ करा
tip: Sorry + माझी चूक होती ('my mistake') lands better than a long explanation. Maharashtrians value owning the mistake in one line.

faqs.question: What is sorry in Marathi?
faqs.answer: माफ करा (māph karā). It also means 'excuse me', so it covers both apologising and politely getting attention.

faqs.question: What is the difference between माफ करा and क्षमस्व?
faqs.answer: माफ करा is everyday speech; क्षमस्व is formal Sanskrit-style, used in speeches and serious apologies.

faqs.question: How do you say excuse me in Marathi?
faqs.answer: The same माफ करा — say it while passing through a crowd or before asking a question.

title: Good Night in Marathi — शुभ रात्री + Bedtime Phrases
description: Good night in Marathi is शुभ रात्री (śubh rātrī). Learn when it is actually said in Maharashtra, bedtime phrases for family, and the casual sign-offs.
lead: Good night in Marathi is शुभ रात्री (śubh rātrī). Unlike English homes, Indian families rarely say it as a nightly ritual — it shines when you are leaving someone at night or ending a call.

answer.en: Good night, see you in dreams

mistakes: ❌ शुभ रात्री as an arrival greeting at a night event → ✅ नमस्कार (good night is a farewell, not a hello)
❌ शुभ रात (dropping ई) → ✅ शुभ रात्री (long ई)
tip: The verb changes with gender: a man says मी जातो, a woman says मी जाते. The greeting शुभ रात्री itself never changes.

faqs.question: What is good night in Marathi?
faqs.answer: शुभ रात्री (śubh rātrī). It is used when parting at night — leaving a gathering, ending a call — more than as a bedtime ritual.

faqs.question: Do Marathi families say good night before bed?
faqs.answer: Usually not — family members simply say जातो/जाते ('I'm off') or nothing at all. शुभ रात्री is for goodbyes.

faqs.question: How do you say sleep well in Marathi?
faqs.answer: चांगली झोप (chānglī zhop). Together: शुभ रात्री, चांगली झोप.

title: What Is Your Name in Marathi — तुमचं नाव काय?
description: What is your name in Marathi is तुमचं नाव काय? (formal) or तुझं नाव काय? (informal). Learn to ask, answer, and the respectful variant.
lead: What is your name in Marathi is तुमचं नाव काय? (tumcha nāv kāy?) — formal and safe with everyone. With children and close friends, तुझं नाव काय? is the informal twin.

phrases.en: How do you write your name?

mistakes: ❌ तुझं नाव काय? to an elder → ✅ तुमचं नाव काय? (तुझं is only for peers, children, juniors)
❌ माझा नाव → ✅ माझं नाव (नाव is neuter, so the possessive is माझं)
tip: Answer with माझं नाव … आहे, then bounce it back: आणि तुमचं? ('and yours?'). That one-word follow-up keeps the conversation alive.

faqs.question: What is your name in Marathi?
faqs.answer: तुमचं नाव काय? (tumcha nāv kāy?) — formal. तुझं नाव काय? is the informal version for friends and children.

faqs.question: How do I say my name is in Marathi?
faqs.answer: माझं नाव … आहे (mājha nāv … āhe). The final आहे ('is') is optional in speech: माझं नाव अमित.

faqs.question: When should I use तुझं vs तुमचं?
faqs.answer: तुझं for friends, younger people, children. तुमचं for elders, strangers, and any formal moment. When unsure, choose तुमचं.

title: I Am Hungry in Marathi — मला भूक लागली आहे
description: I am hungry in Marathi is मला भूक लागली आहे (malā bhūk lāglī āhe). Learn the casual short form, thirsty, and how to ask for food politely.
lead: I am hungry in Marathi is मला भूक लागली आहे (malā bhūk lāglī āhe) — literally 'hunger has attached to me'. Hungry is something that happens to you in Marathi, not something you are.
mistakes: ❌ मी भूक आहे → ✅ मला भूक लागली आहे (the hunger comes TO you — use मला, not मी)
❌ भूक लागला → ✅ भूक लागली (भूक is feminine, so लागली)
tip: The same लागली pattern covers every bodily state: भूक लागली (hungry), तहान लागली (thirsty), झोप लागली (sleepy). Learn one, get three free.

faqs.question: How do you say I am hungry in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला भूक लागली आहे (malā bhūk lāglī āhe). Casual short form: मला भूक लागलीये.

faqs.question: Why do Marathi speakers say hunger 'attached'?
faqs.answer: भूक लागली literally means 'hunger set in'. Marathi frames hunger, thirst and sleep as things that arrive, using the लागली pattern.

faqs.question: How do you say I am thirsty in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला तहान लागली आहे (malā tahān lāglī āhe) — identical pattern, with तहान (thirst).

title: I Don't Know in Marathi — मला माहीत नाही
description: I don't know in Marathi is मला माहीत नाही (malā māhīt nāhī). Learn the casual short form, 'I'm not sure', and how it differs from 'I didn't understand'.
lead: I don't know in Marathi is मला माहीत नाही (malā māhīt nāhī). It is a rescue line you will use daily — and its cousin मला समजलं नाही ('I didn't understand') means something different.
mistakes: ❌ मी माहीत नाही → ✅ मला माहीत नाही ('knowing' happens to you — मला, not मी)
❌ Using समजलं नाही for 'don't know' → ✅ समजलं नाही is 'didn't understand'; not knowing is माहीत नाही
tip: Spelling varies in the wild: माहीत and माहित are both seen. Say it as ma-HEET and either spelling reads fine.

faqs.question: How do you say I don't know in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला माहीत नाही (malā māhīt nāhī). Among friends, the short माहीत नाही works too.

faqs.question: What is the difference between माहीत नाही and समजलं नाही?
faqs.answer: माहीत नाही = I don't know (no information). समजलं नाही = I didn't understand (didn't comprehend what was said).

faqs.question: Is मला माहीत नाही polite?
faqs.answer: Yes — it is neutral. Soften it with माफ करा, मला माहीत नाही ('sorry, I don't know') when talking to strangers.

title: No Problem in Marathi — काही हरकत नाही
description: No problem in Marathi is काही हरकत नाही (kāhī harakat nāhī). Learn the casual चलेल, the reply to धन्यवाद, and when ठीक आहे fits better.
lead: No problem in Marathi is काही हरकत नाही (kāhī harakat nāhī) — literally 'there is no objection'. It is the universal welcome, the universal forgiveness, and the easiest way to put someone at ease.
mistakes: ❌ कोई बात नहीं (Hindi) → ✅ काही हरकत नाही (the Marathi default)
❌ चलेल to your boss → ✅ चलेल is very casual; use काही हरकत नाही at work
tip: चलेल is a famously Marathi shrug — flexible, unbothered, friendly. Wonderful with friends, risky in a job interview.

faqs.question: What is no problem in Marathi?
faqs.answer: काही हरकत नाही (kāhī harakat nāhī). Casual alternative: चलेल (chalel).

faqs.question: How do you respond to sorry in Marathi?
faqs.answer: काही हरकत नाही or ठीक आहे — both mean 'it's fine, don't worry'.

faqs.question: What does हरकत mean?
faqs.answer: Objection or issue. काही हरकत नाही literally says 'there is no objection' — hence 'no problem'.

title: See You Again in Marathi — पुन्हा भेटू & Every Goodbye
description: See you again in Marathi is पुन्हा भेटू (punhā bheṭū). Learn see you later, let's meet soon, the casual जातो!, and how goodbyes work in Marathi.
lead: See you again in Marathi is पुन्हा भेटू (punhā bheṭū) — 'let us meet again'. It comes from भेटणे (to meet), the same verb inside every Marathi goodbye.
mistakes: ❌ अलविदा (alvidā) → ✅ भेटू-family goodbyes (अलविदा sounds like a final farewell, almost never used)
❌ जातो from a woman → ✅ she says जाते (the verb follows the speaker's gender)
tip: Marathi goodbyes are verbs, not nouns: जातो (I go), भेटू (let's meet). Say what YOU are doing, and the goodbye builds itself.

faqs.question: How do you say see you again in Marathi?
faqs.answer: पुन्हा भेटू (punhā bheṭū). For 'see you later' use नंतर भेटू; for 'tomorrow' उद्या भेटूया.

faqs.question: What does भेटू mean?
faqs.answer: It is the 'let's meet' form of भेटणे (to meet) — the root of most Marathi farewells.

faqs.question: How do friends say bye in Marathi?
faqs.answer: A quick जातो! / जाते! ('I'm off') or चल, नंतर भेटू ('ok, see you later').

lead: First meetings in Marathi run on a fixed, friendly script: greeting, name, place, work, and the warm close तुमची भेटून आनंद झाला ('pleased to meet you'). Learn the whole exchange below — then it is yours forever.

dialogue.mr: नमस्कार! मी अमित. तुमचं नाव काय?
dialogue.tr: Namaskār! Mī Amit. Tumcha nāv kāy?
dialogue.en: Hello! I'm Amit. What's your name?

❌ करतो from a woman → ✅ she says करते (मी काम करते)
tip: The verbs carry your gender: a man says करतो, a woman says करते. Practice the dialogue swapping roles — the endings will become automatic.

faqs.question: How do you introduce yourself in Marathi?
faqs.answer: नमस्कार! माझं नाव … आहे ('Hello! My name is …'), then मी … हून आहे ('I'm from …'). That pair covers 90% of first meetings.

faqs.question: How do you say pleased to meet you in Marathi?
faqs.answer: तुमची भेटून आनंद झाला (tumchī bheṭūn ānand jhālā) — literally 'joy came from meeting you'.

faqs.question: Do Marathi introductions use formal or informal pronouns?
faqs.answer: First meetings use तुम्ही (formal you). Shift to तू only when the other person invites it.

answer.en: Will you have a cup of tea?

dialogue.en: Will you have a cup of tea?

mistakes: ❌ चाय (Hindi) → ✅ चहा (the Marathi word — चाय is understood but marks you as a Hindi speaker)

tip: Complimenting the tea (चहा छान झाला आहे!) is social gold in Maharashtra. Even average tea gets a छान — and the host beams.

faqs.question: How do you offer tea in Marathi?
faqs.answer: चहा प्याल का? (chahā pyāl kā?) — 'will you have a cup of tea?'. The short चहा का? also works among friends.

faqs.question: How do you refuse tea politely in Marathi?
faqs.answer: नको, धन्यवाद (nako, dhanyavād — 'no, thank you'). Adding पोट भरलं ('I'm full') softens it further.

faqs.question: What is tea called in Marathi?
faqs.answer: चहा (chahā). Sugar is साखर, and 'one more cup' is अजून प्याल.

description: A real street Marathi dialogue for directions: stopping someone politely, go straight, turn left, how far — with every line transliterated.
lead: Lost in Maharashtra? One dialogue saves you: माफ करा (excuse me) → कुठे आहे? (where is it?) → सरळ जा (go straight). Learn the full street exchange below.

tip: Start every street question with माफ करा — it converts a stranger into a helper before you have even asked.

faqs.question: How do you ask for directions in Marathi?
faqs.answer: माफ करा, [place] कुठे आहे? — 'Excuse me, where is [place]?' Answers usually begin with सरळ जा (go straight).

faqs.question: What are left and right in Marathi?
faqs.answer: डावीकडे (dāvīkade) is left, उजवीकडे (ujavīkade) is right. वळा means 'turn'.

faqs.question: How do you say how far in Marathi?
faqs.answer: किती अंतर आहे? (kitī antar āhe?) — 'how much distance is it?'. A common reply: जवळच आहे (it's close).

description: The Marathi family small-talk dialogue: how many at home, what your parents do, brothers and sisters — with the core family words and polite forms.
lead: Family small talk is how Marathi friendships start. The words are short — आई (mother), बाबा (father), भाऊ (brother) — and the questions repeat in every tea-time chat.

dialogue.en: How many people are there in your home?

dialogue.mr: चार जण — आई, बाबा, भाऊ आणि मी.

❌ भाई → ✅ भाऊ (younger brother; दादा is the elder — and also how you address strangers respectfully!)
tip: दादा (elder brother) doubles as the street word for 'boss/bro' — calling a shopkeeper दादा instantly warms the exchange.

faqs.question: What is family in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कुटुंब (kuṭumba) or घर (ghar, 'home'). Parents are आई-बाबा (mother-father).

faqs.question: What is brother and sister in Marathi?
faqs.answer: भाऊ (bhāū) is younger brother, दादा (dādā) elder brother, बहीण (bahīṇ) is sister.

faqs.question: How do you ask about someone's family in Marathi?
faqs.answer: तुमच्या घरी किती जण आहेत? ('how many people at home?') — the standard friendly opener.

title: Beautiful in Marathi — सुंदर (Sundar) + Compliments
description: Beautiful in Marathi is सुंदर (sundar). Learn to compliment people, places and photos — plus the casual छान, भारी and मस्त register ladder.
lead: Beautiful in Marathi is सुंदर (sundar) — same word, same script as Hindi. The fun lives in the casual ladder below it: छान (lovely), मस्त (great), and Mumbai's भारी (awesome).

phrases.en: You look lovely today (to a woman)

mistakes: ❌ सुंदर for sounds/food → ✅ use छान or मस्त (सुंदर is for visual beauty)
❌ Same compliment to everyone → ✅ दिसतेस (feminine) vs दिसतोस (masculine) — the ending follows the person
tip: Register ladder for daily praise: छान (safe) → मस्त (friendly) → भारी (street). सुंदर stays for genuine beauty — scenery, art, people.

faqs.question: What is beautiful in Marathi?
faqs.answer: सुंदर (sundar) — spelled and pronounced exactly like the Hindi word.

faqs.question: How do you compliment someone in Marathi?
faqs.answer: तू छान दिसतेस/दिसतोस ('you look lovely'). The verb ending follows gender: -तेस feminine, -तोस masculine.

faqs.question: What does भारी mean in Marathi slang?
faqs.answer: Awesome/great — Mumbai's favourite all-purpose positive word. भारी आहे! = 'that's awesome!'

title: I Am Tired in Marathi — मला थकवा आहे
description: I am tired in Marathi is मला थकवा आहे (malā thakavā āhe). Learn the casual मी थकलो, the tiredness pattern, and phrases for the end of a long day.
lead: I am tired in Marathi is मला थकवा आहे (malā thakavā āhe) — literally 'I have tiredness'. Like hunger and sleep, tiredness is something that happens to you, not something you are.

phrases.en: A lot of work happened today

mistakes: ❌ मी थकवा आहे → ✅ मला थकवा आहे (tiredness happens TO you — मला)
❌ थकलो from a woman → ✅ she says थकले (मी थकले आहे)
tip: Same verb family: थकणे (to get tired) → मी थकलो/थकले (I got tired). The -लो/-ले ending follows your gender, exactly like जातो/जाते.

faqs.question: How do you say I am tired in Marathi?

faqs.question: How do you say rest in Marathi?

faqs.question: How do you say I am sleepy in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला झोप लागली आहे (malā zhop lāglī āhe). Casual: मला झोप लागलीये.

faqs.question: How do you say I can't sleep in Marathi?

faqs.question: What is sleep in Marathi?

faqs.answer: मी विसरलो (mī visarlo) — male speech, मी विसरले — female speech. The neutral 'it slipped my mind' is मला विसरलं.

faqs.question: How do you say I forgot to call in Marathi?

faqs.question: What is remember in Marathi?
faqs.answer: आठवणे. 'I remembered' is आठवलं; 'I can't remember' is मला आठवत नाहीये.

faqs.question: How do you say say it again in Marathi?
faqs.answer: पुन्हा म्हणा (punhā mhaṇā) for repeating a word or phrase; पुन्हा सांगा (punhā sāngā) for re-telling information.

faqs.question: What does पुन्हा mean?
faqs.answer: Again. It prefixes many daily verbs: पुन्हा भेटू (see you again), पुन्हा सांगा (say again).

faqs.question: How do you ask someone to speak slowly in Marathi?
faqs.answer: हळू हळू बोला (haḷū haḷū bolā) — polite with strangers; हळू बोल with friends.

faqs.question: How do you say speak slowly in Marathi?
faqs.answer: हळू हळू बोला (haḷū haḷū bolā) — polite. हळू बोल is the informal version for friends.

faqs.question: What does सावकाश mean?
faqs.answer: Slowly/carefully — common in Mumbai local-train announcements and any 'easy does it' context.

faqs.question: Why do Marathi speakers double words?
faqs.answer: Doubling softens and stretches: हळू हळू (slowly), लवकर लवकर (quickly), थोडं थोडं (little by little). It is a core rhythm of spoken Marathi.

faqs.question: What is listen in Marathi?
faqs.answer: ऐकणे (aikaṇe) is to listen. Polite command: ऐका (aikā); informal: ऐक (aik).

faqs.question: How do you say hear vs listen in Marathi?
faqs.answer: Marathi mostly uses ऐकणे for both. 'I heard a sound' = आवाज ऐकला; attentive listening uses the same verb.

faqs.question: How do you say listen to music in Marathi?
faqs.answer: संगीत ऐकणे. 'I am listening to music' = मी संगीत ऐकतो/ऐकते आहे.

faqs.question: How do you say hurry up in Marathi?
faqs.answer: लवकर! alone, or लवकर करा (polite) / लवकर कर (informal). झटपट adds a 'sharpish' urgency.

faqs.question: What does लवकर mean exactly?
faqs.answer: Quickly, soon, or early. लवकर भेटू = see you soon; लवकर उठ = wake up early.

faqs.question: How do you say I am ready in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मी तयार आहे (mī tayār āhe) — the same form for male and female speakers.

faqs.question: How do you say get ready in Marathi?
faqs.answer: तयार हो (informal) or तयार व्हा (polite/plural). Getting ready itself is तयार होणे.

faqs.question: How do you say I am late in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला उशीर झाला आहे (malā ushīr jhālā āhe). Short form: उशीर झाला.

faqs.answer: मी व्यस्त आहे (mī vyasta āhe). The natural everyday alternative is मी कामात आहे ('I'm in work').

faqs.question: What is come in Marathi?
faqs.answer: येणे (yeṇe) is to come. The command is ये (informal) or या (polite/plural).

faqs.question: What is look in Marathi?

tip: Ask for the Hindi meaning too — याचा हिंदी अर्थ काय? — if you already think in Hindi; it wires the new word onto what you know.

faqs.question: How do you ask the meaning of a word in Marathi?
faqs.answer: याचा अर्थ काय? (yāchā arth kāy?). Casual alternative: म्हणजे काय?

faqs.question: What does अर्थ mean?
faqs.answer: Meaning/sense. It is a common Sanskrit-rooted word, identical in Hindi and Marathi.

faqs.question: How do I ask for simpler words?
faqs.answer: सोप्या शब्दात सांगा ('say it in easy words') — सोपं means simple, शब्द means words.

title: When in Marathi — कधी + Time Questions
description: When in Marathi is कधी (kadhī). Learn कधी येशील? (when will you come?), केव्हा, and the answers: आत्ता, नंतर, उद्या.
lead: When in Marathi is कधी (kadhī) — one small word that powers every plan: कधी येता? (when are you coming?).
mistakes: ❌ कब (Hindi) → ✅ कधी (the Marathi 'when')
❌ कधीच for 'sometimes' → ✅ कधीच नाही is 'never'; 'sometimes' is कधी कधी
tip: कधी कधी ('sometimes') is the phrase learners pick up fastest — it doubles as the polite shrug when you don't want to commit to plans.

faqs.question: What is when in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कधी (kadhī). The formal variant केव्हा exists but कधी is what everyone uses.

faqs.question: How do you ask when someone will arrive?
faqs.answer: कधी येता? (to friends/you-formal) or कधी येणार? (when will [he/she] come?).

faqs.question: How do you say never in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कधीच नाही (kadhīch nāhī) — कधी + the emphatic च.

title: Why in Marathi — का? & Every Why-Question
description: Why in Marathi is का? (kā?). Learn why not, why late, and how का attaches to any sentence — the question word that keeps conversations going.
lead: Why in Marathi is का? (kā?) — one tiny word that usually lands at the end of the sentence: उशीर का? (why late?). It is the follow-up question machine of spoken Marathi: answer any statement with का? and the conversation keeps rolling.
mistakes: ❌ क्यों (Hindi) → ✅ का (the Marathi why — completely different word)
❌ का at the start → ✅ Marathi का? (why) sits at the END; का at the start usually means 'is it that?' in yes/no questions
tip: का is the follow-up question machine: answer + का? keeps any conversation rolling. झालं. — का? — बरं झालं!

faqs.question: What is why in Marathi?
faqs.answer: का? (kā?) — usually placed at the end of the sentence: उशीर का? (why late?).

faqs.question: How do you say why not in Marathi?
faqs.answer: का नाही? (kā nāhī?) — also the standard way to say 'sure, why not' when agreeing.

faqs.question: What is the difference between का and काय?
faqs.answer: काय = what; का = why. One vowel apart — listen carefully in fast speech.

title: Who in Marathi — कोण? & People Questions
description: Who in Marathi is कोण? (koṇ?). Learn who is that, who called, whose is this, and the कोणी/कोण difference.
lead: Who in Marathi is कोण? (koṇ?) — the word behind every people-question you will ask: तो कोण? (who is he?), who called, whose is this. One root, a handful of endings, endless daily use.
mistakes: ❌ कौन (Hindi) → ✅ कोण (the Marathi who)
❌ कोण vs कोणी mix-up → ✅ कोण asks 'who exactly'; कोणी is 'someone/anyone' in statements
tip: Whose is this? = हे कोणाचं? — the कोण family stretches to कोणाचं (whose), कोणाला (to whom), कोणाशी (with whom).

faqs.question: What is who in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कोण? (koṇ?). तो कोण? = who is he; तुम्ही कोण? = who are you (formal).

faqs.question: How do you say whose in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कोणाचा / कोणाची / कोणाचं — the ending follows the gender of the thing owned. हे कोणाचं? = whose is this?

faqs.question: What is the difference between कोण and कोणी?
faqs.answer: कोण asks for a specific person. कोणी means someone/anyone: दारावर कोणी आहे का? (is anyone at the door?)

title: I Am Happy in Marathi — मला आनंद झाला
description: I am happy in Marathi is मी आनंदी आहे (mī ānandī āhe). Learn 'I felt happy', congrats replies, and the आनंद family words.
lead: I am happy in Marathi is मी आनंदी आहे (mī ānandī āhe). For moments of joy, Marathi reaches for the event form: मला आनंद झाला ('joy happened to me').
mistakes: ❌ मी आनंद आहे → ✅ मी आनंदी आहे (आनंद is the noun 'joy'; the adjective is आनंदी)
❌ मला खुश झालं → ✅ मला आनंद झाला (the natural 'I felt happy' event form)
tip: मला … झाला is the emotional event frame: आनंद झाला (felt happy), दुःख झाले (felt sad), राग आला (got angry). Learn the frame, swap the feeling.

faqs.question: How do you say I am happy in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मी आनंदी आहे (mī ānandī āhe). For 'I felt happy (about that)': मला आनंद झाला.

faqs.question: What does आनंद mean?
faqs.answer: Joy/happiness — the same word as Hindi आनंद, also a popular name.

faqs.question: How do you congratulate in Marathi?
faqs.answer: शुभेच्छा! (śubhechchhā!) or अभिनंदन! (abhinandan!) — both work for achievements and festivals.

title: I Am Sad in Marathi — मला दुःख झाले
description: I am sad in Marathi is मला दुःख झाले (malā duḥkh jhāle). Learn उदास, comforting phrases, and how Marathi talks about sadness.
lead: I am sad in Marathi is मला दुःख झाले (malā duḥkh jhāle) — 'sadness happened to me'. The everyday word is उदास (udās), shared with Hindi.
mistakes: ❌ मी दुःखी आहे (overly strong for daily use) → ✅ मन खराब आहे for a bad mood; दुःख झाले for real sadness
❌ दुख (missing the ः) → ✅ दुःख in careful writing; दुख is common in casual typing
tip: The kind reply to anyone feeling low: बरं होईल ('it'll be okay') + चहा प्या (have some tea). Comfort is beverage-based in Maharashtra.

faqs.question: How do you say I am sad in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मी उदास आहे (mī udās āhe) or मन खराब आहे ('feeling low'). For deeper sadness: मला दुःख झाले.

faqs.question: What does दुःख mean?
faqs.answer: Sorrow/pain — the same word as Hindi दुख, pronounced with the soft ः.

faqs.question: How do you comfort someone in Marathi?
faqs.answer: बरं होईल ('it will be okay'), चिंता करू नकोस ('don't worry'), and a cup of चहा.

title: I Am Angry in Marathi — मला राग आला
description: I am angry in Marathi is मला राग आला (malā rāg ālā). Learn राग येणे, क्षमस्व apologies after anger, and calming phrases.
lead: I am angry in Marathi is मला राग आला (malā rāg ālā) — 'anger came to me'. Anger arrives, like everything else in Marathi feeling-talk.
mistakes: ❌ मुझे गुस्सा आया (Hindi) → ✅ मला राग आला (गुस्सा is Hindi; Marathi uses राग)
❌ राग आली → ✅ राग आला (राग is masculine)
tip: शांत हो ('calm down') is for friends — with someone truly furious, switch to the respectful शांत होऊ नका… actually simply say nothing and offer चहा. The beverage strategy never fails.

faqs.question: How do you say I am angry in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला राग आला (malā rāg ālā) — 'anger came to me'. Habitually angry: मला राग येतो.

faqs.question: What is angry in Marathi?
faqs.answer: The state is रागावलेला/रागावलेली; a short-tempered person is रागीट.

faqs.question: How do you say calm down in Marathi?
faqs.answer: शांत हो (śānt ho) — informal. The verb शांत होणे means to become calm.

title: Delicious in Marathi — चव छान आहे!
description: Delicious in Marathi is चव छान आहे (chav chhān āhe — 'the taste is lovely'). Praise the food like a local: स्वादिष्ट, मस्त, घरचं खाऊन आनंद झाला.
lead: Delicious in Marathi is चव छान आहे (chav chhān āhe) — literally 'the taste is excellent'. The textbook word स्वादिष्ट exists, but plates get praised with चव.
mistakes: ❌ स्वादिष्ट to grandma → ✅ correct but bookish; चव छान आहे melts hearts faster
❌ गरम for spicy → ✅ spicy is तिखट; गरम is only temperature
tip: The highest praise in any Maharashtra kitchen: घरचं खाऊन आनंद झाला — 'eating home food brought me joy'. Say it and you get invited back.

faqs.question: How do you say delicious in Marathi?
faqs.answer: चव छान आहे (chav chhān āhe — 'the taste is lovely'). The formal single word is स्वादिष्ट (svādiṣṭa).

faqs.question: What is taste in Marathi?
faqs.answer: चव (chav). 'It has no taste' = चवच नाही; 'spicy' = तिखट.

faqs.question: How do I compliment the cook in Marathi?
faqs.answer: खूप छान झालं! ('turned out very well!') or the gold standard: घरचं खाऊन आनंद झाला.

title: Maybe in Marathi — कदाचित, बहुतेक & Hedging Words
description: Maybe in Marathi is कदाचित (kadāchit). Learn बहुतेक, होते-नाही असे, and the everyday hedge words that soften every commitment.
lead: Maybe in Marathi is कदाचित (kadāchit) — but daily speech hedges with बहुतेक ('probably') and the noncommittal होते-नाही असे ('it comes and goes').
mistakes: ❌ शायद (Hindi) → ✅ कदाचित / बहुतेक (the Marathi hedges)
❌ कदाचित in every sentence → ✅ daily speech prefers बहुतेक and पाहू; कदाचित is the written register
tip: पाहू ('we'll see') is the gentlest no in Marathi. Nobody takes it as commitment — it's the polite way to keep a door open.

faqs.question: What is maybe in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कदाचित (kadāchit). Everyday speech also uses बहुतेक ('probably') and पाहू ('we'll see').

faqs.question: How do you say probably in Marathi?
faqs.answer: बहुतेक (bahutek) — also 'mostly/most'. बहुतेक होईल = it will probably happen.

faqs.question: How do I hedge politely in Marathi?
faqs.answer: खात्री नाही ('not sure') + पाहू ('we'll see') — the standard non-committal pair.

title: Buying Bus Tickets in Marathi — Counter Dialogue
description: A real Marathi bus-counter dialogue: which bus, one ticket to Pune, departure time, platform — every line transliterated with tap-to-listen.
lead: The Marathi bus counter runs on four questions: where to, how many, what time, which platform. Learn this one dialogue and every MSRTC window in Maharashtra opens for you.

answer.en: Which platform does it leave from?

dialogue.mr: माफ करा, पुण्याची बस कधी सुटते?
dialogue.tr: Māph karā, Puṇyāchī bas kadhī suṭute?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, when does the Pune bus leave?
One ticket please. How much is it?

mistakes: ❌ टिकट (Hindi) → ✅ तिकीट (the Marathi ticket)
❌ बस कहाँ जाती है? → ✅ बस कुठे जाते? or ask your destination: पुण्याची बस कधी सुटते?
tip: The magic word at any counter: द्या ('give') — एक तिकीट द्या, एक चहा द्या. Polite, short, and never wrong.

faqs.question: How do I ask for a bus ticket in Marathi?
faqs.answer: एक तिकीट द्या (ek tikīṭ dyā — 'one ticket, please'). Add the destination: पुण्याला दोन तिकिटं (two tickets to Pune).

faqs.question: How do I ask when the bus leaves?
faqs.answer: बस कधी सुटते? (bas kadhī suṭute?) — सुटणे is the verb 'to depart'.

faqs.question: What is the ticket office called in Marathi?
faqs.answer: तिकीटघर (tikīṭghar) — literally 'ticket house'. Look for that sign at stations.

title: Pharmacy in Marathi — औषध मिळेल का? Dialogue
description: A Marathi chemist dialogue: headache medicine, fever tablets, how to take them, and the price — every line transliterated.
lead: One dialogue covers every chemist visit: डोकेदुखीचं औषध मिळेल का? ('will I get headache medicine?') — then dosage, price, and a polite thanks.

dialogue.mr: माफ करा, डोकेदुखीसाठी औषध मिळेल का?
dialogue.tr: Māph karā, ḍokedukhīsāṭhī auṣadh miḷel kā?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, will I get medicine for headache?

dialogue.mr: ही गोळी सकाळी आणि रात्री घ्या.
dialogue.tr: Hī goḷī sakāḷī āṇi rātrī ghyā.
dialogue.en: Take this tablet morning and night.

mistakes: ❌ दवाई (Hindi) → ✅ औषध (the Marathi medicine — दवाई is heard but Hindi-flavoured)
❌ मुझे बुखार है (Hindi) → ✅ मला ताप आहे (the Marathi fever is ताप)
tip: Always end with हे कसं घ्यायचं? ('how do I take this?') — chemists explain dosage happily, and the answer is a free listening lesson.

faqs.question: How do I ask for medicine in Marathi?
faqs.answer: [Problem] साठी औषध मिळेल का? — e.g. डोकेदुखीसाठी औषध मिळेल का? (will I get headache medicine?)

faqs.question: What is fever in Marathi?
faqs.answer: ताप (tāp). Headache is डोकेदुखी; body-ache is अंगदुखी.

faqs.question: How do I ask how to take the medicine?
faqs.answer: हे कसं घ्यायचं? (he kasaṁ ghyāychaṁ?) — 'how is this to be taken?'

title: Hotel Check-In in Marathi — खोली मिळेल का? Dialogue
description: A Marathi hotel dialogue: is a room free, for how many nights, hot water, the key — every line transliterated for small-town Maharashtra stays.
lead: Small-town Maharashtra hotels run on one exchange: खोली मिळेल का? ('will I get a room?') — then nights, price, hot water, and the key. Learn it once, stay anywhere.

dialogue.en: Hello, will I get a room?

mistakes: ❌ कमरा (Hindi kamrā) → ✅ खोली (the Marathi room)
❌ कितना किराया? → ✅ भाडं किती? (the Marathi rent/price question)
tip: Confirm the two essentials before paying: गरम पाणी आहे का? and पाणी चालतं का? ('does the water run?') — veteran travellers always ask both.

faqs.question: How do I ask for a room in Marathi?
faqs.answer: खोली मिळेल का? (kholī miḷel kā?) — 'will I get a room?'. Add nights: दोन रात्रींसाठी (for two nights).

faqs.question: How do I ask the room price in Marathi?
faqs.answer: भाडं किती? (bhāḍaṁ kitī?) — भाडं is rent/charge.

faqs.question: How do I ask about hot water?
faqs.answer: गरम पाणी आहे का? (garam pāṇī āhe kā?) — the most important hotel question in winter.

title: Vegetable Stall in Marathi — भाजी कितीची? Dialogue
description: The classic Marathi भाजी-वाला dialogue: tomato price, freshness check, bargaining, and the famous उसटी करा finish — every line transliterated.
lead: The vegetable stall is where daily Marathi lives: टोमॅटो कशाचं? (how much are tomatoes?), हे ताजं आहे का? (is it fresh?), and the gentle dance of उसटी करा.

dialogue.en: Excuse me, tomatoes at what price?

dialogue.mr: खूप महाग! हे ताजं आहे का?
dialogue.tr: Khūp mahāg! he tājaṁ āhe kā?

dialogue.en: Came in this morning. See for yourself.

dialogue.mr: आधा किलो द्या. उसटी करा हं!
dialogue.tr: Ādhā kilo dyā. usaṭī karā haṁ!
dialogue.en: Half a kilo. Round it down, eh!

mistakes: ❌ भिंडी का भाव? (Hindi frame) → ✅ भिंडी कशाची? (the Marathi price question — the ending matches the noun's gender)
❌ सस्ता करो → ✅ उसटी करा / थोडं कमी करा (the Marathi bargain moves)
tip: Gender agreement shows in the price question: टोमॅटो कशाचं? (neuter), भिंडी कशाची? (feminine), कांदा कशाचा? (masculine). Vendors will still understand you either way.

faqs.question: How do I ask vegetable prices in Marathi?
faqs.answer: [Vegetable] कशाचं/कशाची/कशाचा? — 'at what price?' The ending follows the vegetable's gender, but कितीचं? always works.

faqs.question: How do I ask for half a kilo?
faqs.answer: आधा किलो द्या (ādhā kilo dyā). A full kilo is पाव किलो... no — पाव is a quarter; a full kilo is पाऊस? No: एक किलो द्या.

faqs.question: What does उसटी करा mean?
faqs.answer: Literally 'make it loose' — round the price down to a neat number. The beloved closing move of every Marathi market trip.

title: Sweet Shop in Marathi — गोड द्या! Dialogue
description: A Marathi मिठाई दुकान dialogue: half a kilo of sweets, pack it, taste one — the festival and guest-visit script, transliterated line by line.
lead: Festivals, weddings, guests — every happy Marathi occasion passes a sweet-shop counter. The script: गोड द्या (give sweets), half a kilo, pack it properly.

answer.en: Give a quarter kilo of sweets

dialogue.en: Hello! How much is this sweet (per unit)?

dialogue.mr: पाव किलो द्या. चवीला एक द्या का?
dialogue.tr: Pāv kilo dyā. chavīlā ek dyā kā?
dialogue.en: A quarter kilo. Can I taste one?

mistakes: ❌ मिठाई (Hindi) → ✅ गोड (the Marathi 'sweets' — मिठाई is understood but Hindi-flavoured)
❌ आधा किलो for quarter → ✅ पाव किलो is a quarter; आधा किलो is half
tip: पाव (quarter), अडा (half-kilo-ish), पाऊण (three-quarters) — sweet shops run on these fractional words. पाव किलो द्या is the most-ordered phrase in Maharashtra.

faqs.question: How do I order sweets in Marathi?
faqs.answer: पाव किलो गोड द्या (pāv kilo god dyā — 'give a quarter kilo of sweets'). Swap the amount: अडा किलो (half), अधिक... just say the number.

faqs.question: What are sweets called in Marathi?
faqs.answer: गोड (god) — literally 'sweet'. Individual sweets keep their names: लड्डू, बर्फी, जिलेबी.

faqs.question: How do I ask to taste before buying?
faqs.answer: चवीला एक द्या (chavīlā ek dyā — 'give one to taste'). Shopkeepers usually offer it themselves.

title: Asking for Leave in Marathi — सुट्टी Dialogue
description: A workplace Marathi dialogue: one day leave, feeling unwell, tomorrow's work covered — polite office phrases for real Indian workplaces.
lead: Asking for leave in Marathi is a polite, short exchange: सुट्टी हवी आहे ('I need leave'), the reason, and the reassurance that tomorrow's work is covered.

answer.en: Give me one day's leave tomorrow

dialogue.mr: माफ करा, उद्या एक दिवस सुट्टी हवी आहे.
dialogue.tr: Māph karā, udyā ek divas suṭṭī havī āhe.
dialogue.en: Sorry, I need one day's leave tomorrow.

dialogue.mr: मला ताप आहे. डॉक्टरांकडे जायचं आहे.
dialogue.tr: Malā tāp āhe. ḍoktarāṅkaḍe jāychaṁ āhe.
dialogue.en: I have a fever. I need to see the doctor.

mistakes: ❌ मुझे छुट्टी चाहिए (Hindi) → ✅ मला सुट्टी हवी आहे (the Marathi leave request)
❌ सुट्टी द्या alone → ✅ add the duration: एक दिवस / दोन दिवस सुट्टी द्या — clarity reads as professionalism
tip: The winning leave formula: reason + covered work + thanks. मला ताप आहे, काम पूर्ण झालं, धन्यवाद! — approved in seconds.

faqs.question: How do I ask for leave in Marathi?
faqs.answer: उद्या एक दिवस सुट्टी द्या (udyā ek divas suṭṭī dyā) — 'give me one day's leave tomorrow'. सुट्टी is both holiday and leave.

faqs.question: How do I say I'm unwell at work in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला ताप आहे (fever), डोकेदुखी आहे (headache), अंगदुखी आहे (body-ache) — the three classics.

faqs.question: How do I say the work is done in Marathi?
faqs.answer: काम पूर्ण झालं (kām pūrṇa jhālāṁ) — the sentence every manager wants to hear.

title: Lunch Break in Marathi — जेवायला चला! Dialogue
description: Office lunch-break Marathi: shall we eat, what's in your tiffin, canteen food, tea after — the colleague small talk that builds friendships.
lead: Lunch is when office Marathi becomes friendship Marathi: जेवायला चला? ('shall we eat?'), टिफिनमध्ये काय आहे? ('what's in your tiffin?'), and the eternal post-lunch चहा.

title: Classroom Questions in Marathi — शंका विचारू Dialogue
description: A student-teacher Marathi dialogue: I have a doubt, please repeat, what does this word mean, homework — the polite classroom script.

answer.en: I want to ask a question

dialogue.mr: माफ करा, मला एक प्रश्न विचारायचा आहे.
dialogue.tr: Māph karā, malā ek praśnā vicchārāychā āhe.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, I want to ask a question.

dialogue.mr: हे शब्द मला समजले नाहीत. पुन्हा सांगा.
dialogue.tr: He śabda malā samajale nāhīt. punhā sāngā.
dialogue.en: I didn't understand these words. Please repeat.

mistakes: ❌ सर बोलो धीरे (mixed Hindi) → ✅ सर, हळू हळू बोला (Marathi students say सर/मॅम + the Marathi request)

faqs.question: How do I ask a question in a Marathi classroom?

faqs.answer: शिक्षक (śikṣak, male) / शिक्षिका (śikṣikā, female). Students also say सर and मॅम.

faqs.question: How do I say it doesn't fit in Marathi?
faqs.answer: बसत नाहीये (basat nāhīye) — 'it doesn't fit'. For size: साईज लहान/मोठं आहे (size is small/big).

title: Cricket Talk in Marathi — कालचा सामना बघितलास का?
description: A Marathi cricket-chat dialogue: did you watch the match, what a shot, India won — sports small talk with every line transliterated.
lead: Cricket small talk is social glue in Maharashtra: कालचा सामना बघितलास का? ('did you watch yesterday's match?') — and the whole chai-stall debate follows.

dialogue.en: India won in the end — brilliant!

mistakes: ❌ मैच देखा (Hindi) → ✅ सामना बघ (the Marathi watch-the-match)
❌ जीता (Hindi won) → ✅ जिंकला (the Marathi won — जिंकणे)
tip: सामना is the Marathi word for match. षटकं (overs), चौकार (four), षटकार (six) — three words and you can follow any chai-stall commentary.

faqs.question: How do I talk about cricket in Marathi?
faqs.answer: Start with कालचा सामना बघितलास का? ('did you watch yesterday's match?') — the universal opener.

faqs.question: What is a match called in Marathi?
faqs.answer: सामना (sāmnā). To win is जिंकणे — भारत जिंकला (India won).

faqs.question: How do I say what a shot in Marathi?
faqs.answer: काय शॉट! or the Marathi classic झक्कास! ('superb!') — both work at any local screening.

title: Morning Routine in Marathi — उठलास का? Dialogue
description: A Marathi morning dialogue: are you up, brush your teeth, have tea, hurry for the bus — the household wake-up script.
lead: Marathi mornings have a script: उठलास का? ('are you up?'), चहा तयार आहे ('tea is ready'), लवकर कर, बस सुटते! ('hurry, the bus leaves!').

dialogue.en: Are you up? Tea is ready.

mistakes: ❌ नहा लो (Hindi) → ✅ आंघोळ कर (the Marathi bath — आंघोळ is the beloved Marathi word)
❌ नाश्ता करो → ✅ नाश्ता कर (same word, Marathi imperative — नाश्ता is shared vocabulary)
tip: आंघोळ (bath) is one of the most Marathi words there is — Hindi speakers say नहाना, Marathi speakers say आंघोळ करणे. Drop it in a sentence and you sound local.

faqs.question: How do you say are you up in Marathi?
faqs.answer: उठलास का? (uṭhalās kā?) — informal, to family. Formal: उठलात का?

faqs.question: How do you say take a bath in Marathi?
faqs.answer: आंघोळ करणे (ānghoḷ karaṇe). मी आंघोळ केली = I had a bath.

faqs.question: What is breakfast in Marathi?
faqs.answer: नाश्ता (nāśtā) — same as Hindi. नाश्ता कर = have breakfast.

title: Study Session in Marathi — अभ्यास झाला का? Dialogue
description: A Marathi study dialogue: is homework done, which lesson, teach me this, exam tomorrow — students and parents both need this one.
lead: Study talk at home: अभ्यास झाला का? ('is your study done?'), कोणता धडा? ('which lesson?'), हे मला शिकव ('teach me this') — the family homework script.

dialogue.en: I'll solve and show you. Don't worry.

mistakes: ❌ पढ़ाई की? (Hindi) → ✅ अभ्यास झाला का? (the Marathi study-done question)
❌ समझ नहीं आया → ✅ समजलं नाही (the Marathi didn't-understand)
tip: अभ्यास is the standing word for study/homework — अभ्यास कर (do your study) is the most-uttered sentence in every Maharashtrian home at 7 pm.

faqs.question: How do I ask if homework is done in Marathi?
faqs.answer: अभ्यास झाला का? (abhyās jhālā kā?) — the daily question of every parent.

faqs.question: What is exam in Marathi?
faqs.answer: परीक्षा (parīkṣā). उद्या परीक्षा आहे = there's an exam tomorrow.

faqs.question: How do I say teach me in Marathi?
faqs.answer: मला शिकव (malā śikav) — informal. मला शिकवा is the polite form.

title: Client Meeting in Marathi — भेटीसाठी धन्यवाद
description: A Marathi business dialogue: welcoming a client, discussing the order, timeline, next steps — formal register, every line transliterated.
lead: Client meetings in Marathi are warm-formal: भेटीसाठी धन्यवाद ('thanks for meeting'), ऑर्डरबद्दल बोलूया ('let's discuss the order'), पुढची पायरी काय? ('what's the next step?').

dialogue.en: Hello! Thanks for meeting. Please sit.
Thank you. Let's discuss the order.
We can deliver within ten days.
Good. What will the price be?

dialogue.mr: कोटेशन पाठवतो आजच. पुढची पायरी म्हणजे संमती.
dialogue.tr: Koṭeśan pāṭhavto ājach. puḍhachī pāyarī mhaṇaje sammatī.
dialogue.en: I'll send the quotation today. The next step is your approval.

mistakes: ❌ Casual तू with a client → ✅ तुम्ही + -ता/-ते endings throughout — business Marathi is तुम्ही-register
❌ डेडलाइन only → ✅ कधी पुरवू शकता? ('by when can you deliver?') says it natively
tip: Close every meeting with पुढची पायरी काय? ('what's the next step?') — it shows professionalism and gives you a natural goodbye: पुढच्या भेटीपर्यंत (until the next meeting).

faqs.question: How do I welcome a client in Marathi?
faqs.answer: नमस्कार! भेटीसाठी धन्यवाद — 'hello, thank you for the meeting'. बसा (please sit) follows naturally.

faqs.question: How do I discuss an order in Marathi?
faqs.answer: ऑर्डरबद्दल बोलूया ('let's discuss the order') — बद्दल makes any topic discussable: किंमतीबद्दल, वेळेबद्दल.

faqs.question: How do I ask the delivery date in Marathi?
faqs.answer: कधी पुरवू शकता? (kadhī purvū śaktā?) — 'by when can you deliver?'
